Yousa advise-ed to take defens-ive cover or combackie to Otoh Gunga immidyetly.|Neb Nob to Boss Nass|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core">''[[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core]]''</ref>}}
'''Goodrow Neb Nob''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Neb Nob lived in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Gungan society]], under the rule of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]]. That year, Neb Nob worked at the [[Otoh Gunga Traffic Control]] and once reported that a [[seaquake]] was located five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] south of Boss Nass's position.
